profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Rooted in a background supported by Medicaid, I've witnessed the transformative impact of access to assistance. Exploring the profound influence of technology in healthcare, I’ve seen firsthand its significance in telemedicine, electronic health records, and health applications. This personal experience fueled my commitment to giving back and forging access for communities often left behind during technological advancements. As a full-stack engineer, I'm enthusiastic about leveraging my technical expertise and unwavering dedication to align with a company that shares my mission of creating a lasting impact and using technology to enhance accessibility and quality of life. With a robust foundation in adaptable problem-solving and a proven track record of goal-driven work, I am poised to be a valuable asset to your team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Developed full-stack web applications with different frameworks and backend support
•  Designed interactive websites with responsive features able to be read across all platforms 
•  Collaborated with a small team to build and debug code

positions.title: Frontend Web Development Fellow
positions.description:
​•  Created websites using web languages such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that allow users to access and interact with the site
•  Collaborated with other web development fellows to redesign websites for nonprofit organizations
positions.insights: HTML, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +1 skill

company.name: University of the Sciences in Philadelphia

positions.title: Campus Ambassador
positions.description:
• Engaged with prospective students and families during visits, promoted the university by providing information and sharing personal experiences resulting in excellent feedback from families and following up on social media for continued connection
• Maintained connection with prospective students and families by answering questions and offering support in the college decision process
• Assisted the Admissions office staff with event coordination and set up

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
• Supplemented departments by creating an inventory system for several supply sites, resulting in greater efficiency and a reduction in unnecessary spending
• Assisted professors in research through data intake and equipment management
• Became a point of contact in office management and as a result, was entrusted with larger and independent projects
• Set up classrooms by allocating appropriate equipment and ensuring space was ready for students
positions.insights: Office Cleaning, Inventory Management and +4 skills

positions.description: Teachers Assistant for Seminar for the Health Sciences

projects.title: Thought Bubbles
projects.description: Thought Bubbles Is a twist on a traditional to-do list. Inputs such as tasks or thoughts go in different "thought bubbles". Users can add as many as they want, and delete thoughts by double-clicking the bubble.
